blocks.source: Vol III, Conclusion, § Open Questions Within the Digital Boundary
blocks.md: The safety case for this incident establishes a bounded claim, that an approved configuration change produced acceptable service behavior under a declared contract. Even with every policy boundary enforced, every tool call sandboxed, and every transition logged, three systems questions remain open: how completely acceptance criteria capture service health, how to stay consistent when production state changes during deliberation, and how far the audit trail supports causal attribution.
